name: Cafe DReAMLAND
source:
This is Cafe "DReAMLAND".
Cafe clerk Yatsume has one job: To make drinks for the strange "customers" that stop by the cafe. 

Not just any drinks, though: have a wish? With just a hint of blasphemy, these drinks can help make it "come true".

Strange? Maybe. For Yatsume, though, that's just business as usual.

However, after a certain someone drops by for a special visit, Yatsume comes to learn about the secret behind the shop, and the truth behind the whole world...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296260/Cafe_DReAMLAND/]Steam page[/url]]
translation:
这是咖啡馆“DReAMLAND”。
咖啡馆店员八目有一份工作：为路过咖啡馆的陌生“顾客”制作饮料。

不过，不仅仅是饮料：有愿望吗？只要有一丝亵渎，这些饮料就可以帮助它“成真”。

奇怪的？或许。但对八目来说，一切如常。

然而，在某个人专程拜访后，八目得知了商店背后的秘密，以及整个世界背后的真相……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3296260/Cafe_DReAMLAND/]Steam页面[/url]]
